items.t: CVT whine, shudder or slipping
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used or aftermarket CVT costs less. A fluid change may help a mild case first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Test occupant sensor; replace seat cushion sensor if needed
items.note: Low end is a test only; high end includes a new seat cushion with sensor. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Steering gear cover screw may loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten steering gear screw and add cover plate
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Driver-side wiring connector can corrode and short (recall)
items.job: Replace kick panel wiring connector and seal
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. Cost rises if water damaged other wiring or modules.

items.t: Power steering assist may cut out (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering control unit
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT judder, hesitation and failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Some mild cases are fixed by a software update and fluid change. Ask a dealer about extended CVT coverage.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Liftgate support struts can corrode and break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Under-dash connector corrosion (recall)
items.job: Replace wiring connector and add waterproof seal
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. Cost rises if water damaged other wiring or modules.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or replace occupant sensor control unit
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Dash wiring connector can corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace wiring connector and add waterproof seal
items.note: Free under recall; check the VIN. Cost rises if water damaged other wiring or modules.

items.t: Rear brake calipers may leak fluid (recall)
items.note: Includes bleeding the brakes. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Fuel pump may overheat and fail (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: VC-Turbo engine bearing failure (recall)
items.note: Recall adds a software update and replaces the engine free if damaged. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Engine oil can break down and seize bearings (recall)
items.note: Recall adds a software update and oil pan check, and replaces the engine free if needed. Check the VIN.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioners may be built wrong (recall)
items.note: Price is for both front belts. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Electronic throttle body gears may break (recall)
items.job: Replace throttle body and update engine software
items.note: Many cars need only the software update. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rearview camera screen may stay blank (recall)
items.note: Software fix, often over the air, done free under recall. Check the VIN.

items.t: Selected gear may not show on the dash (recall)
items.note: Many cars only need an inspection. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT drops into fail-safe mode and limits speed
items.job: Replace CVT valve body and add external fluid cooler
items.note: A badly damaged CVT needs replacement instead.

items.t: All-wheel-drive coupling judders in slow tight turns
items.note: Needs unit characteristics writing with a Nissan scan tool after fitting.

items.t: Oil cooler gasket leaks engine oil
EVAP vent valve sticks and lights the check engine light
Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit in tank
